blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Learning executable motions from human videos offers a scalable solution for humanoid robots to acquire demonstration motions. However, existing pipelines typically first construct an explicit human motion representation and then convert it into robot motions via motion retargeting. Although such methods can effectively leverage large volumes of existing human data for training, the substantial differences between humans and humanoid robots in locomotion mechanisms and joint degree-of-freedom configurations make motions generated by this human-representation-centric approach difficult to execute on robots. Furthermore, errors introduced during human motion estimation inevitably propagate to the retargeting stage and cannot be eliminated via joint optimization.
We propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to robot motions. Discarding the explicit human representation, this framework learns robot-oriented implicit representations directly from visual observations, enabling the model to capture cross-morphology motion structures. To generate motions more suitable for robot execution, we further design a contact-aware motion optimization mechanism to improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Experiments show that BeyondRetarget significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of generated robot motions, while achieving higher execution success rates and lower latency in both simulation environments and real humanoid robots.
Project page is available at BeyondRetarget .
blocks.zh:
从人体视频中学习可执行的运动,为人体机器人获得演示运动提供了可伸缩的解决方案. 然而,现有的管道通常首先构建一种明确的人类运动表现,然后通过运动重定向将其转化为机器人运动. 虽然这些方法可以有效地利用大量现有人类数据进行培训,但人类和人造机器人在运动机制和联合自由度配置方面的巨大差异,使得这种以人类代表为中心的方法所产生的运动难以在机器人身上执行. 此外,人类运动估计过程中出现的错误不可避免地传播到重新瞄准阶段,无法通过联合优化消除。
我们提议BeyondReoctarget,一个端到端的框架,直接将单光的RGB视频映射给机器人运动. 这个框架抛弃了明显的人类表现,直接从视觉观测中学习到面向机器人的隐含表现,使模型能够捕捉到跨形态运动结构. 为了产生更适合机器人执行的运动,我们进一步设计了一种接触感运动优化机制,以提高时间一致性和物理可信度. 实验显示,BeyondReoctarge大大提高了生成的机器人运动的准确性和稳健性,同时在模拟环境和真人机器人中都实现了更高的执行成功率和较低的耐久性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large-scale, executable motion data serve as a fundamental foundation for humanoid robots to perform skill learning and whole-body control. However, such data is typically acquired using specialized systems such as optical motion capture ( Vicon Motion Systems Ltd., 2026 ) and wearable inertial sensors ( Schepers et al., 2010 ) , which require dedicated hardware and controlled capture environments, leading to high costs and difficulties in large-scale deployment ( Schepers et al., 2010 ) . In contrast, monocular RGB videos are abundant and low-cost to collect. Therefore, monocular videos represent a highly promising data source for large-scale acquisition of robot motion data.
blocks.zh: 大规模,可执行的运动数据是人造机器人进行技能学习和全身控制的根本基础. 然而,这类数据的获取通常使用专门系统,如光学运动捕捉系统(Vicon Motion Systems Ltd., 2026年)和可穿戴惯性传感器(Schepers等人, 2010年),它们需要专门的硬件和控制的捕捉环境,导致大规模部署成本高,难度大(Schepers等人, 2010年). 相比之下,单色的RGB视频是丰富的,收集成本低廉的. 因此,单视视频是大规模获取机器人运动数据的极有希望的数据源.

blocks.en: Benefiting from recent advances in human motion capture techniques, monocular RGB videos can be converted into unified explicit human motion representations ( Shin et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ) , such as Skinned Multi-Person Linear Model (SMPL) ( Loper et al., 2015 ) . Built upon this mature human motion representation, existing video-based robot motion generation methods typically adapt a two-stage pipeline: reconstructing human motion from RGB videos first, then retargeting human motion onto the target robot ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Allshire et al., 2025 ; Roux et al., 2026 ) . This pipeline fully leverages the high similarity in overall structure and motion patterns between humans and humanoid robots, enabling extraction and transfer of meaningful motion patterns from human movements, and thus achieves promising results in most scenarios.
blocks.zh: 得益于人类运动捕捉技术的近期进步,单体RGB视频可以转换为统一的显性人类运动表现(Shin等人,2024年;Shen等人,2024年),如Skinned Multiperson Linear Model(SMPL)(Loper等人,2015年). 以这种成熟的人类运动表现为基础,现有的基于视频的机器人运动产生方法一般会调整一个两级的管道:首先从RGB视频中重建人类运动,然后将人类运动重新瞄准目标机器人(Fu等人,2024年;Allshire等人,2025年;Roux等人,2026年). 这种管道充分利用了人类与人造机器人在整体结构和运动模式上的高度相似性,使得人类运动中有意义的运动模式得以提取和转移,从而在大多数情况下都取得了有希望的结果.

blocks.en: However, the similarity between humans and humanoid robots mainly lies in global morphology and kinematic structure, while notable discrepancies remain in body proportions, joint degrees of freedom (DoF), motion dynamics and other aspects. Consequently, the human-centric SMPL intermediate representation is not inherently suited for describing robot motion. Furthermore, the two-stage decomposition propagates human motion reconstruction errors from the first stage directly into the subsequent retargeting process, which compound with retargeting errors and form error accumulation that cannot be eliminated via joint optimization. Although the two-stage method provides a natural and effective solution for video-to-robot motion generation, its human-centric intermediate representation limits the capability to directly model motion within the robot space.
blocks.zh: 然而,人类和人造机器人的相似性主要在于全球形态学和动能结构,而在身体比例,自由度(DoF),运动动力学和其他方面仍存在显著差异. 因此,以人为中心的SMPL中间代表在本质上并不适合描述机器人运动. 此外,两阶段的分解将人类运动重建错误从第一阶段直接传播到随后的重定向过程,这与重定向错误复合,形成无法通过联合优化消除的错误积累. 虽然双阶段方法为视频对机器人运动生成提供了自然有效的解决方案,但其以人为中心的中间代表限制了在机器人空间内直接建模运动的能力.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly generates executable humanoid robot motion from monocular RGB videos. The core idea is to eliminate the explicit SMPL intermediate representation and instead learn an implicit, robot-oriented motion representation directly from visual observations. This representation can be optimized directly for cross-morphology target robot motion generation. Furthermore, it can be mapped to motions of any target humanoid robot via robot-specific decoders. We establish geometric correspondences between humans and robots via a set of semantic keypoints and semantic link directions, and constructs a unified supervision mechanism to directly supervise robot motion using SMPL-based data. To improve motion executability, a contact-aware optimization module identifies foot contact states, determines support states, and performs kinematic corrections to enhance temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Figure 1 illustrates the core modifications brought by this work.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议BeyondReoctar,一个端到端的框架,直接从单光谱的RGB视频中产生可执行的人体机器人运动. 核心思想是取消明显的SMPL中间代表,而是直接从视觉观察中学习一种隐含的,面向机器人的运动表现. 这种表现可以直接优化用于跨形态目标机器人运动生成. 此外,还可以通过机器人专用解码器将它映射到任何目标人造机器人的运动上。 我们通过一组语义键位和语义链接方向来建立人类和机器人之间的几何通信,并构建一个统一的监督机制,利用基于SMPL的数据直接监督机器人的运动. 为了提高运动可执行性,一个接触意识优化模块确定脚接触状态,确定支持状态,并进行运动矫正,以提高时间一致性和物理可信度. 图1说明了这项工作带来的核心变化。

blocks.en:
Experiments demonstrate that BeyondRetarget can generate accurate, robust, and executable humanoid robot motions from monocular videos.
Compared with conventional two-stage pipelines, BeyondRetarget achieves lower pose errors and substantially reduces severe motion collapse, while more faithfully reproducing human motions and maintaining stable execution in both simulation and real-robot settings. Moreover, the shared motion features and unified supervision scheme enable efficient adaptation to diverse humanoid embodiments. These results demonstrate the potential of BeyondRetarget to transform the abundant and easily accessible monocular videos into high-quality executable robot motion data, providing a scalable and low-cost approach for large-scale robot motion data acquisition.
blocks.zh:
实验证明,BeyondReocter能够从单视视频中产生准确,坚固,可执行的人体机器人运动.
与常规的两阶段管线相比,BeyondReobject实现较低的布局差错,并大大减少严重运动崩溃,同时更忠实地复制人类运动,在模拟和真机器人环境下保持稳定的执行. 此外,共享运动特征和统一监督计划能够有效地适应各种人造物的表现形式。 这些结果显示,BeyondReocal有可能将丰富且易于获取的单视视频转换成高质量的可执行机器人运动数据,为大规模机器人运动数据采集提供了可扩展和低成本的方法.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We propose an end-to-end framework that directly generates executable humanoid robot motion from monocular human videos , providing a convenient solution for acquiring a large-scale data for humanoid robots. • We propose an implicit, shared robot-oriented motion representation , together with a unified human-robot supervision mechanism, enabling this shared representation to be decoded onto different humanoid robot embodiments. • We introduce explicit contact and support representation to refine the estimated motion for improved temporal and physical consistency . • We systematically evaluate our method in both simulation and real-world robot platforms , showing superior motion accuracy, robustness, execution success rate and real-time performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing methods for generating robot motion data typically follow a two-stage pipeline ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Allshire et al., 2025 ; Roux et al., 2026 ) , first recovering explicit human motion and then retargeting it to robots. This paper reviews related work from two aspects: human motion data acquisition and representation, and human-to-robot motion retargeting.
blocks.zh: 生成机器人运动数据的现有方法通常遵循两阶段管道(Fu等人,2024年;Allshire等人,2025年;Roux等人,2026年),首先恢复显性人类运动,然后重新瞄准机器人. 本文从两个方面回顾了相关工作:人类运动数据的获取和表示,以及人对机器人运动重定向.

blocks.en:
Human motion acquisition and representation. Traditional systems capture human motion by tracking optical markers ( Vicon Motion Systems Ltd., 2026 ) or fusing wearable inertial and magnetic measurements ( Schepers et al., 2010 ) . The captured motion is represented as marker trajectories ( Loper et al., 2014 ) or skeletal joint positions and rotations ( Ionescu et al., 2014 ; Huang et al., 2018 ) . These systems provide detailed measurements but require dedicated hardware and venues, limiting collection at scale.
Parametric body models subsequently link skeletal motion to body shape and surface deformation ( Anguelov et al., 2005 ) . MoSh fits such models to sparse markers ( Loper et al., 2014 ) , while SMPL provides a shared mesh topology and skeletal structure ( Loper et al., 2015 ) . SMPL’s consistent pose and shape parameters offer a common interface for learning and retargeting across heterogeneous data sources. MANO and SMPL-X extend this representation to articulated hands and expressive bodies ( Romero et al., 2017 ; Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) . AMASS unifies 15 optical motion-capture datasets in a common SMPL-based representation ( Mahmood et al., 2019 ) , while BEDLAM uses synthetic bodies and motion to scale image-based supervision ( Black et al., 2023 ) . MotionPRO and RICH further connect motion to pressure and scene contact ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
人类运动获得和代表. 传统系统通过追踪光学标记(Vicon Motion Systems Ltd.,2026)或引信可穿戴惯性和磁性测量来捕捉人类运动(Schepers等人,2010年). 被捕获的运动作为标记轨迹(Loper等人,2014年)或骨骼联合位置和旋转(Ionescu等人,2014年;Huang等人,2018年)作为代表. 这些系统提供详细的测量,但需要专门的硬件和场地,限制规模的收集。
参数体模型随后将骨骼运动与身体形状和表面变形联系起来(Angelov等人,2005年)。 MoSh与这种模型匹配于稀疏的标记(Loper等人,2014年),而SMPL则提供了共享的网状地形和骨骼结构(Loper等人,2015年). SMPL的一贯姿势和形状参数为不同数据来源的学习和重新定位提供了一个共同的接口。 MANO和SMPL-X将这一表述扩展至清晰的手和表达体(Romero等人,2017年;Pavlakos等人,2019年). AMAS将15个光学运动捕捉数据集统一在一个基于SMPL的常见代表(Mahmood等人,2019年)中,而BEDLAM则使用合成体和运动来缩放基于图像的监控(Black等人,2023年). MotionPRO和RICH进一步将运动与压力和现场接触联系起来(Ren等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年;Huang等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
With these parametric body models providing a consistent representation of human motion, monocular RGB videos have emerged as an attractive source for scalable motion acquisition due to their abundance and ease of collection without specialized hardware. Single-image estimation evolved from model fitting to learned regression ( Bogo et al., 2016 ; Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Goel et al., 2023 ) . Recovering motion, however, requires consistency across frames. Video methods therefore introduced temporal encoding and learned motion priors ( Kanazawa et al., 2019 ; Kocabas et al., 2020 ; Luo et al., 2020 ) , followed by stronger temporal context and attention mechanisms ( Choi et al., 2021 ; Wan et al., 2021 ) .
WHAM further refines trajectories using contact information ( Shin et al., 2024 ) , while GVHMR introduces gravity-view coordinates to reduce global recovery ambiguity ( Shen et al., 2024 ) . Together, these developments expand the data sources for motion acquisition, enabling monocular videos to be converted into structured human motion data, which can be transformed into corresponding robot action data through a retargeting pipeline.
blocks.zh:
由于这些参数体模型为人类运动提供了一致的体现,单色的RGB视频因其丰富多彩且易于收集而无需专门的硬件,因此成为可伸缩运动获取的有吸引力的来源. 单一图像估计从适合模型演变为学习回归(Bogo等人,2016年;Kanazawa等人,2018年;Goel等人,2023年)。 然而,恢复运动需要各框架的一致性。 因此,视频方法引入了时间编码和学习运动前传(Kanazawa等人,2019年;Kocabas等人,2020年;Luo等人,2020年),之后是更强的时间背景和关注机制(Choi等人,2021年;Wan等人,2021年)。
WHAM利用联系信息进一步完善轨迹(Shin等人,2024年),而GVHMR引入重力视野坐标以减少全球恢复模糊性(Shen等人,2024年). 这些发展共同拓宽了运动获取的数据源,使得单视视频能够转换成结构化的人类运动数据,可以通过重定向管道转换成相应的机器人动作数据.

blocks.en:
Human-to-robot motion retargeting. Retargeting transfers human motion to robots with different kinematics while preserving motion characteristics under robot constraints.
Early approaches establish hand-designed correspondences between human and robot joints, followed by motion scaling, inverse kinematics, and trajectory modification ( Pollard et al., 2002 ; Nakaoka et al., 2003 ; Ude et al., 2004 ) . These methods establish the basic human-to-robot motion generation pipeline but require substantial robot-specific design.
More recently, optimization-based methods formulate retargeting as constrained motion matching, jointly considering motion fidelity, morphology, and feasibility ( Liarokapis et al., 2013 ; Ayusawa and Yoshida, 2017 ; Darvish et al., 2019 ) . GMR ( Araujo et al., 2025 ) is a representative recent approach that further improves motion fidelity and addresses physical artifacts. However, such non-convex optimization can be sensitive to initialization and objective design, leading to local collapse or discontinuous joint trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
To avoid these numerical instabilities, learning-based methods directly learn mappings from human to robot motion ( Villegas et al., 2018 ; Aberman et al., 2020 ) . NMR ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , for example, learns a robot motion mapping from high-quality paired supervision, improving inference stability and smoothness. However, the learned mapping is coupled to the target robot and training distribution, making adaptation to new robot morphologies costly. Another line of work ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) maps human motion representations to latent commands for direct use in downstream control. While such latent interfaces reduce reliance on explicit retargeting, they provide less interpretable robot motion and limited access to complete trajectories for inspection and editing.
blocks.zh:
人对机器人运动重定向. 重新瞄准将人类运动转移给具有不同运动力的机器人,同时在机器人的限制下保留运动特性.
早期方法建立人与机器人关节之间手动设计的通信,然后是运动缩放、逆动能和轨迹改变(Pollard等人,2002年;Nakaoka等人,2003年;Ude等人,2004年)。 这些方法建立了基本的人对机器人运动生成管道,但需要实质性的机器人特定设计.
最近,基于优化的方法将重新定位为受约束的运动匹配,共同考虑运动的忠诚性、形态和可行性(Liaryokapis等人,2013年;Ayusawa和Yoshida,2017年;Darvish等人,2019年)。 格林尼治平时 (Araujo等人,2025年)是一种具有代表性的近期方法,它进一步提高了运动忠诚度,并解决了物理文物问题。 然而,这种非对流优化可以对初始化和客观设计敏感,导致局部崩溃或不连续的联合轨迹(赵等人,2026年).
为了避免这些数值不稳定,基于学习的方法直接学习从人到机器人运动的绘图(Villegas等人,2018年;Aberman等人,2020年). 例如NMR(Zhao et al., 2026)从高质量的对映监督中学习机器人运动绘图,提高推论稳定性和光滑度. 然而,所学的绘图与目标机器人和训练分布相结合,使得适应新的机器人形态的成本高昂. 另一行工作(Luo等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年)将人类运动表现图映射到潜伏指令中,直接用于下游控制. 虽然这种潜在接口减少了对明确重定向的依赖,但它们提供了不太易解释的机器人运动,并且限制了检查和编辑所需的完整轨迹。

blocks.en: Overall, explicit robot motion remain a high-quality and indispensable source of data for robot motion learning and imitation. However, existing methods for acquiring such data typically decouple human motion capture from robot motion retargeting, resulting in inherent limitations such as information bottlenecks and error accumulation that limit the quality of generated motion.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,明确的机器人运动仍然是机器人运动学习和模仿的高质量和不可或缺的数据来源. 然而,获取此类数据的现有方法通常会将人类运动捕捉从机器人运动重定向中脱钩,从而导致信息瓶颈和误差积累等固有限制,限制了生成运动的质量.

blocks.en: 3.2 Unified Motion Supervision and Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 统一动议监督和培训

blocks.en: Human pose parameters and robot’s DoF differ in dimension and kinematic meaning, making supervision infeasible during training. In order to directly use human body annotations for training, we introduce a non-uniform scaling method that establishes a shared set of keypoints between human and robot, and adapts SMPL to the morphology of the target humanoid robot, thereby transferring motion supervision to a unified geometric space.
blocks.zh: 人类的姿势参数和机器人的DOF在维度和运动意义上不同,使得监管在训练中不可行. 为了直接使用人体说明来进行训练,我们采用了非统一缩放方法,在人与机器人之间建立一组共享的关键点,并使SMPL适应目标人体机器人的形态,从而将运动监督转移到一个统一的几何空间.

blocks.zh: 3.3 改进联系方式

blocks.en: Figure 4: Contact-aware kinematic refinement. The robot’s lower limb are divided into contact or support states based on explicit contact representation, and optimized via corresponding post-processing to improve the physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 图4:接触意识动态改进。 机器人的下肢根据明显的接触表现分为接触状态或支持状态,并通过相应的后处理进行优化,以提高物理可信度.

blocks.en: The estimator is capable of generating complete robot motion. However, accurate poses inferred from visual inputs do not necessarily yield physically executable motions. This is because the executability of robot motion largely depends on temporal consistency and contact stability, whereas the unified motion supervision scheme provides insufficient constraints on these two properties. To address this issue, we first freeze the motion estimator, filter its generated motions, then introduce explicit contact representations to guide subsequent motion optimization.
blocks.zh: 估计器能够产生完整的机器人运动. 然而,从视觉输入中推断出的准确面孔不一定产生可实际执行的动议。 这是因为机器人运动的可执行性很大程度上取决于时间一致性和接触稳定性,而统一运动监督计划则对这两个属性提供了不足的限制. 为了解决这个问题,我们首先冻结了运动估计器,过滤了它产生的运动,然后引入明确的接触表示,以指导随后的运动优化.

blocks.en: Specifically, after motion training, we fix estimator’s parameters and train a contact predictor under pressure data supervision ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . This predictor fuses the motion feature with the visual feature to predict the contact probability of each foot. As illustrated in Figure 4 , we use a two-level state decision. First, we convert the predicted contact probability c ^ t , f ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \hat{c}_{t,f}\in[0,1] of each foot f f into a binary contact state c t , f ∈ { 0 , 1 } c_{t,f}\in\{0,1\} , where 0 0 denotes no contact and 1 1 denotes contact. We then obtain the foot trajectory and its horizontal velocity v t , f x ​ y v_{t,f}^{xy} through forward kinematics. A contacted foot is regarded as being in the support state only when its horizontal velocity is below the threshold τ v \tau_{v} : s t , f = c t , f ∧ ( ‖ v t , f x ​ y ‖ 2 ≤ τ v ) . s_{t,f}=c_{t,f}\land\left(\left\|v_{t,f}^{xy}\right\|_{2}\leq\tau_{v}\right).\vskip-2.84526pt (7) | | ⋅ | | 2 ||\cdot||_{2} denotes the vector norm. This distinction separates feet that are in contact with the ground but still moving from those providing stable support. The contact state triggers root height correction: we eliminate height offsets to prevent foot penetration or floating. The support state additionally enables root horizontal correction and lower-body inverse kinematics (IK) solving to ensure no sliding of stably supporting feet. This hierarchical structure maintains stable support feet while naturally allowing sliding for moving contact feet. To avoid abrupt changes caused by support state switching, we apply a temporal smoothing filter Filt ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{Filt}(\cdot) to the residual sequence and add the filtered correction to the original prediction to obtain the final refined joint posture. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Setup. We train on MotionPRO ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , which provides synchronized RGB images, optical motion capture SMPL ground truth (GT), and foot contact labels, covering approximately 12,000,000 frames and over 400 action categories. SMPL GT supervises robot motion, while foot contact labels are used to train the contact predictor. We train the model on Unitree G1, and adapt each additional humanoid (Unitree R1, Fourier GR1-T1, Fourier GR2-V3, Unitree H1, Booster T1, Tienkung, and Atlas) by retraining its joint and root orientation branches in the robot‑specific decoder. Adapting a new robot takes approximately one hour on a single RTX 4090. We compare against GVHMR ( Shen et al., 2024 ) /WHAM ( Shin et al., 2024 ) combined with NMR ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) /GMR ( Araujo et al., 2025 ) . To isolate errors from human motion reconstruction, Oracle baseline uses SMPL GT for direct retargeting.

SMPL GT监督机器人运动,同时脚接触标签用于训练接触预测器. 我们在Unitree G1上训练模型,并通过在机器人的专用解码器中再培训其联合和根方向分支来改造每个额外的人形(Unitree R1,Fourier GR1-T1,Fourier GR2-V3,Unitree H1,Boster T1,Tienkung,和Atlas). 改造新机器人大约需要1小时的单机RTX 4090. 我们比较了GVHMR(Shen等人,2024年)/WHM(Shin等人,2024年)与NMR(Zhao等人,2026年)/GMR(Araujo等人,2025年)结合. 为了从人类运动重建中分离出错误,甲骨文基线使用SMPL GT进行直接重定向.

blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate local pose, global trajectory, temporal continuity, physical plausibility and executability through the following metrics. Morphology-Aligned MPJPE ( MAMPJPE , mm) measures the keypoint error after aligning the reference human body with the robot morphology, while Root Trajectory Error ( RTE , mm) measures root trajectory error after rigid alignment. Torso Direction Error (TDE, ∘ ) and End-effector Direction Error (EDE, ∘ ) are used to measure the angular errors of the torso vector and the end-effector vector relative to the GT vector, respectively. Jitter (10 m/s 3 ) and Accel (mm/frame 2 ) measure higher order temporal jitter and acceleration error. Foot sliding (FS, mm/frame) measures the unintended horizontal displacement of the feet during support frames, while Violation rate (Viol., %) measures the proportion of contact frames exhibiting foot floating or ground penetration. Fail 65 (%) and Fail 100 (%) measure the proportions of windows whose average MAMPJPE exceeds 65 mm and 100 mm, respectively, over the total number of windows (each consists of 200 frames). Executed Success Rate (Exec. SR, %) measures the ratio of successfully executed clips to the total number of clips in physical simulation (Mujoco). We use a general motion tracker SONIC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) to execute the output motion, and a motion clip (each consists of 600 frames) is considered failed if its execution is terminated before reaching the end of the reference motion due to excessive root height, root orientation, or end-effector height errors. Executed Morphology-Aligned MPJPE (Exec. MAMPJPE , mm) measures the accuracy of the executed motion.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Two-Stage Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与两阶段方法的比较

Table 1 compares pose, trajectory, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. BeyondRetarget consistently outperforms all two-stage methods across MAMPJPE , RTE, Jitter, and Foot Slide, demonstrating that end-to-end estimation improves motion accuracy, temporal consistency and physical plausibility. More importantly, BeyondRetarget eliminates severe pose collapse: no evaluated window exceeds either the 65 mm or 100 mm MAMPJPE threshold, while all two-stage methods exhibit such collapse. This indicates that removing the intermediate human representation not only improves average accuracy but also substantially enhances robustness.
As illustrated in Figure 5 (a), for large-amplitude motions such as arm swings, two-stage pipelines suffer from misplaced limbs and pose collapse, whereas the direct estimation approach preserves motion characteristics more faithfully. For fine-grained actions, such as the hands-behind-the-waist poses, all two-stage methods incorrectly place the hands in front of the body, whereas BeyondRetarget accurately reconstructs the hands-behind-the-back motion.

blocks.en: To isolate retargeting error from human estimation error, we evaluate an Oracle setting where SMPL GT is directly fed into the retargeting module. BeyondRetarget still achieves lower MAMPJPE than both Oracle retargeting baselines, demonstrating that the retargeting stage itself introduces non-negligible motion errors and providing further evidence for avoiding the intermediate human model.
blocks.zh: 为了将重定向误差与人类估计误差隔离开来,我们评价一个甲骨文设置,将SMPL GT直接输入重定向模块. 在Retarget之外,MAMPJPE仍比两个Oracle重定向基线都低,表明重定向阶段本身引入了不可忽略的运动错误,并为避免中间人类模型提供了进一步的证据.

blocks.en: Finally, in physical simulation, BeyondRetarget achieves a 347/362 (95.86%) success rate with a Exec. MAMPJPE of 35.04 mm, outperforming all two-stage pipelines using estimated human motion. Together, these results show that direct estimation improves RGB-to-robot motion accuracy, avoids pose collapse introduced by retargeting, and produces more executable reference motions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: Conclusion. We present BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that generates executable humanoid robot motion from monocular human videos. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves higher accuracy, robustness, executability and real-time performance compared with two‑stage pipelines. It can also scale to adapt to diverse humanoid embodiments, offering a new scheme for convenient, large‑scale acquisition of multi-robot motion data.
blocks.zh: 结论。 我们提出BeyondReoctar,一个端到端的框架,从单人视频中生成可执行的人体机器人运动. 实验表明,与两阶段管道相比,我们的框架实现了更高的准确性、稳健性、可执行性和实时性能。 它还可以扩大规模,以适应各种人造化,为方便、大规模地获取多机器人运动数据提供新办法。

blocks.en: Limitations. Constrained by model capacity and training data distribution, our method can still exhibit errors in global trajectory estimation for large-range human motions or when the camera is noticeably moving. In addition, our current method do not cover complex terrains or contact-rich human–environment interaction scenarios. Future work could incorporate more diverse data and model scene geometry and physical contacts, thus enabling robots to directly learn more challenging, scene-conditioned motion skills from videos.
blocks.zh: 限制。 受模型能力和训练数据分布的限制,我们的方法仍然能够显示全球轨迹估计中大范围人类运动或照相机明显移动时的错误。 此外,我们目前的方法并不涵盖复杂的地形或富于接触的人类与环境相互作用情况。 今后的工作可以包括更多样化的数据和模型场景几何和物理接触,从而使机器人能够直接从视频中学习更具挑战性,场景条件的运动技能.
